sources.notes: Resolve acquisition .meta4 records before planning; never treat OPDS length as a digest.
Resolve an immutable release through STAC, then select themes/types and a bounding box. Never hardcode latest.
Regional OSM PBF extracts with checksum sidecars; retain ODbL attribution.
Pin project, dump date, multistream index, and upstream checksums; compute SHA-256 locally.
Use the official bounded OPDS or bulk RDF catalogue rather than crawling pages; retain the license embedded in each title.
Resolve a dated dump and checksum files; do not plan against the mutable latest alias.
Official snapshot documentation. A future adapter must resolve anonymous S3 entity manifests, tolerate their documented refresh-time absence, and verify the manifest is stable across acquisition.
Annual DOI metadata JSON Lines; resolve the release page to exact archives and independently compute SHA-256.
Select explicit item identifiers and original files; item availability never substitutes for per-item rights review.
Daily tab-delimited gazetteer exports with CC BY attribution and modification/deletion feeds.
Pin scale, theme, release, archive length, and locally computed SHA-256 before installation.
Resolve concrete bulk export links from the official data page instead of relying on directory listing; retain database and image-license obligations separately.
Expert opt-in selective WARC materialization only; crawl availability does not grant content rights.
